purpose: Coin door service buttons and dedicated switches (states_ref; factory settings, attract mode). Proves which PinMAME input reaches which ROM key: the coin door dispatcher 0xfc20 is called with r0 = the button mask from the dedicated switch table 0x040f4074 (BACK 1, MINUS 2, PLUS 4, SELECT 8).

GI relay from power-on through attract, game, tilt warnings, tilt and the next ball (states_ref). GI hooks: gi_write = the strobe-register shadow 0x3c758 bit 0 is changed (0xc958 sets it = GI off, 0xc970 clears it = GI on, 0xc914 = power-up init 0xfe); gi_req = a task asks for GI off/on (0xcaf8 / 0xcb24); gi_out = PinMAME's GI output (core_write_pwm_output_8b(CORE_MODOUT_GI0, ~data & 1)).

Match, FORCED LOSS (states_ref): as match_win.txt but adj 30 MATCH PERCENTAGE = 0, so rate 0 >= 0 takes the no-win branch at 0x1b770: the drawn number 40 (which would match) is stepped +10 to 50 until no player matches.

Match, natural draw (states_ref, factory settings except adj 38 BALL SAVE TIME = 0 so each drain ends the ball). trace rng logs every random(n) call: the match number is random(10)*10 at 0x1b6ac (caller 0x1b6b0).

Match, forced WIN (states_ref, factory settings except adj 38 BALL SAVE TIME = 0). Same play as match_natural.txt (final score 757,740 -> last two digits 40). pokeat writes RNG seed 0xa7bf957a just before random(10) at 0x1b6ac, so the LCG gives next=0x73333333 and random(10)=4 -> match number 40 = score%100 -> P1 wins (rate 0 < adj 30 = 9).

Two-player game (states_ref, factory settings): rotation, per-player state, shoot again in a multi-player game, a short START press on ball 2 (adj 36 GAME RESTART needs a 1 s hold), end of game. Poke used: player 1 extra ball lit on ball 2 (as in rules/traces/game_flow.txt). adj 38 BALL SAVE TIME = 0 (operator setting) so that every drain ends the ball and the rotation is easy to follow.

Three-player game (states_ref). adj 38 BALL SAVE TIME = 0 so that every drain ends the ball (operator setting). Starts as a 2-player game; player 3 is added with coins + START after P1's ball 1 is in play (playfield valid). Then: player 2 tilts on ball 1 (the tilt ends only P2's ball, P3 is next); an attempt to add a 4th player on ball 2 (expected: refused, players can only be added on ball 1). No pokes.

Four-player game (states_ref). adj 38 BALL SAVE TIME = 0 so that every drain ends the ball (operator setting). Pokes: player 3 extra ball lit on ball 1 (0x3d46e, 0x2111896); player 3 score = 60,000,000 on ball 3 (beats HIGH SCORE #1 55 M) to show the high-score entry in a multi-player end of game.
Slam tilt during a game (states_ref: button slam = PinMAME key HOME = dedicated switch D18). Expect deff 24, leff 12 (GI off), sound 0x018, then a machine reset (~5 s); credits and the game are lost.

Sea of Simulation stages 4-8 (QUORRA, DISC, LIGHT CYCLE, RECOGNIZER, TRON) - POKED scenario (states_ref/tron_ref). Pokes: all 9 item "lit" bytes = 1 and items 0-3 (FLYNN, GEM, CLU, ZUSE) "collected" bytes = 1 for player 1 (item i at 0x2111694 + 0x10*i: byte 0 lit, byte 1 collected; see rules/modes/sea_of_simulation.md), so the VUK starts SOS and stages 0-3 are skipped (each pays its one-time skip bonus (k+1) M) and play begins at stage 4. Watch: sos_watch.tsv.

Tilt cancels: ball save, a running multiball (Disc Multiball) and modes; then slam is in slam_tilt.txt. states_ref with event tracing (event_post ids: 0x65 tilt hooks, 0x66 tilt, 0x67 after tilt, 0x1d end-of-ball stop). Factory settings (adj 32 TILT WARNINGS = 2, adj 38 BALL SAVE 5 s).
